items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket leaks coolant or oil
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and bolts, flush coolant, change oil
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $900; TrueDelta owners report about $580 for the gasket job.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit

items.t: Harsh or slipping shifts from a pressure control solenoid
items.job: Replace transmission pressure control solenoid

items.t: Transmission drops into neutral at highway speed
items.job: Replace transmission control valve body

items.t: Power window falls down or stops working
items.job: Replace power window regulator (and motor if needed)
items.note: Owners report about $300 to $500 at a shop.

items.t: Power window switch fails
items.job: Replace power window switch
items.note: Owners report $45 to $50 for the part.

items.t: Sludge in the coolant leads to overheating
items.job: Flush cooling system and refill with fresh coolant
items.note: Does not include fixing the leak that caused it.

items.t: Misfire from a failing ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil
items.note: One owner reports $245 for a coil pack.

items.t: ABS warning light comes on
items.job: Replace front wheel speed sensor

items.t: Front wheel bearing growls
items.job: Replace front hub and bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Worn struts, springs and control arms
items.job: Replace front struts or lower control arms (pair) and align
items.note: Owners report about $220 for struts and $450 for lower control arms.

items.t: Rear drum brakes stick or seize
items.job: Replace rear brake shoes, drums and hardware (both sides)

items.t: Blower fan only works on high
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor

items.t: ABS motor short can cause an underhood fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair ABS motor and brake pipe (recall 99V-170)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Wiper system repair (recall 99V-348)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Headlights cannot be aimed correctly (recall)
items.job: Headlamp aiming remedy (recalls 98V-102 and 99V-356)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Dim headlight bulbs (recall)
items.job: Replace headlamp bulbs (recall 04V-375)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Rear wheel can shift and steer the car (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair rear drum brake assembly (recall 00V-143)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Seat belt buckle may not hold in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt buckles (recall 00V-228)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Rear seat belt anchors may pull loose (recall)
items.job: Install new seat belt anchor bolts (recall 95V-173)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.
